<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Diels‑Alder reaction, I will query the template catalog for templates that form carbon‑carbon bonds (the characteristic new bonds of a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition). I’ll request a small number of results to keep the search cheap.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O", "bonds_formed": ["C-C"], "limit": 5}</action_input>
